items.headline: Bennett totals 3 TDs in Baylor’s 44-3 win over Prairie View A&M
items.description: — Backup quarterback Nate Bennett threw two touchdown passes and ran for another score to lead Baylor to a 44-3 victory over Prairie View A&M on Saturday night.

items.headline: Sources: Baylor QB DJ Lagway ruled out; Nate Bennett to start
items.description: Baylor QB DJ Lagway will not play Saturday against Prairie View A&M after suffering an ankle injury, with Nate Bennett making his first start, sources told ESPN.

items.headline: Auburn's Winter: Game-saving play vs. Baylor 'happened in slow-mo'
items.description: Safety Eric Winters recaps his crucial play from the Tigers' Week 1 win, telling the SEC Now crew it was all instinct and that his "phone is still going crazy."
